Service

A garage in Paralimni

LPM Automotive Garage works at Agias Sofias 5 in Paralimni. Its Facebook page describes a certified mechanic specialised on Mercedes and BMW, and 24 of its 26 Google reviews give five stars. Customers come from the area, from holidays in Cyprus and, as one writes, even from Nicosia.

What customers say

Three of 26 Google reviews, all three with five stars.
